subtitulo: Smoke Tree Road · Grand Senora Desert
contenidoMarkdown:
Abandoned Vehicle 1

Smoke Tree Road · Grand Senora Desert

The Taser Trap in the Desert

  • ›Location: Smoke Tree Road, deep in the Grand Senora Desert (near the Sandy Shores airfield).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will spot a seemingly abandoned Surfer van beside a dirt track. As you approach to inspect it, an ambusher will come up behind you and shoot you with a stun gun (Taser). If you don't react in time, you will pass out and wake up in your underwear on the railroad tracks with a train barreling toward you.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If you are playing as Trevor Philips, activate his Rage special ability the moment you hear the shot: it will cancel the Taser's paralysis, letting you take down the attacker and get your hands on his stun gun early, before it unlocks at Ammu-Nation.
  • ›Reward: Stun gun (Taser) (with Trevor) and the Surfer van.

subtitulo: RON Alternates Wind Farm · Wind Farm
contenidoMarkdown:
Abandoned Vehicle 2

RON Alternates Wind Farm · Wind Farm

The Encounter at the Wind Farm

  • ›Location: Dirt tracks of the RON Alternates Wind Farm.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will find a Journey camper van parked among the wind turbines. As you approach the vehicle, you will interrupt two people in the middle of an intimate moment. If they catch you, you get too close, or you hit the camper's bodywork, they will storm out furious, in their underwear and brandishing firearms, trying to kill you.
  • ›Tactical Tip: This event triggers more easily at dusk or at night. If you sneak up without hitting the bodywork, you can hear their peculiar dialogue from outside before they panic and come out armed at close range.
  • ›Reward: Journey vehicle and ammo recovered from the attackers.

Cop Arrest 1

O'Neil Farmstead · Grapeseed

Chase in Grapeseed

  • ›Location: Near the O'Neil farmstead, in Grapeseed.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will witness a police officer chasing a suspect on foot along the shoulder of the rural road. The game gives you complete freedom to choose your moral side: cooperate with the law or favor the fugitive.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you decide to help the officer, shoot the fugitive directly in the legs (or hit him at low speed with the nose of your vehicle) to immobilize him without killing him.
  • ›If you decide to help the runaway by taking down the police officer, the criminal will thank you on the spot by handing you a cash reward before disappearing across the countryside.
  • ›Reward: $250 in cash and a 2-star wanted level if you back the escape; no cash reward if you help the police.

Cop Arrest 2

Senora Freeway · Wind Farm

The Ranger on Senora Freeway

  • ›Location: Side of the Senora Freeway, level with Rex's Diner (wind farm).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A state park ranger is chasing an armed fugitive on foot along the edge of the highway. As with the Grapeseed arrest, you can step in on the side of law and order or on the side of crime.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If you go for the fugitive's easy money, get a fast car ready before opening fire on the authorities, since two wanted stars on an open highway will bring high-speed patrol cars almost immediately.
  • ›Reward: $250 in cash and a 2-star wanted level if you back the suspect's escape.

subtitulo: ATM Locations · Various San Andreas Points
contenidoMarkdown:
ATM Robbery

ATM Locations · Various San Andreas Points

Stepping In at the ATM

  • ›Location: Various ATMs (Fleeca and Maze Bank) scattered across Los Santos and Blaine County.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will hear the cries of a defenseless pedestrian as a pickpocket snatches the money he just withdrew from the ATM and flees in a hurry on foot or on a scooter. You must chase the thief before he slips out of your line of sight.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Once the criminal is neutralized, pick up the wad of bills from the ground. You will have two options:
  • ›Return the loot to the victim: The victim will thank you with 10% of the amount ($50 - $200) and your special ability bar will instantly refill to 100%.
  • ›Keep the wallet: If you prefer the money, make a run for it with the full haul (between $500 and $2,000 clean).
  • ›Reward: Between $500 and $2,000 (if you keep the money) or a full special ability refill and a small tip (if you return it).

Bike Thief 1

Little Bighorn Avenue · Rancho

The Animal Ark Stroke of Luck

  • ›Location: Little Bighorn Avenue, in the Rancho neighborhood (South Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A criminal steals a defenseless citizen's bicycle in broad daylight. Chase the thief on foot or ram him with a vehicle to recover the bike and give it back to its original owner.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Do not ignore this event under any circumstances. Although it looks like a minor street errand, the bicycle's owner turns out to be a senior business executive. A few days after you return his bike, he will send you a thank-you email telling you that he has put $100,000 worth of Animal Ark shares in your name on the LCN stock exchange.
  • ›Reward: Instant +3 Stamina and $100,000 in Animal Ark shares, delivered later by email.

Bike Thief 2

Bridge Street · Hawick

Chase in Hawick

  • ›Location: Bridge Street, in the central Hawick district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A pedestrian has his bicycle snatched in a flash on the sidewalk. Chase the thief while dodging city traffic, recover the bike and hand it over to the victim.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If you decide to keep the bicycle, you will not get the physical stat boost. It is far more worthwhile to return it to speed up your character's progression.
  • ›Reward: +3 Stamina when you return the vehicle.

subtitulo: Mount Haan Road · Grand Senora Desert
contenidoMarkdown:
Border Patrol 1

Mount Haan Road · Grand Senora Desert

Ambush at Mount Haan

  • ›Location: Side tracks of Mount Haan Road, in the Grand Senora Desert.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A group of xenophobic rural militiamen, armed to the teeth, will cut you off on motorcycles and pickup trucks, accusing you of being an illegal immigrant no matter which protagonist you play.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Find solid rock cover right away or answer with submachine guns from the vehicle before getting out. The attackers carry pump-action shotguns that are deadly at close range.
  • ›Reward: Up to $700 in cash dropped by the attackers when they fall, plus their weapons and ammo.

Border Patrol 2

Tataviam Mountains

Harassment in the Tataviam Mountains

  • ›Location: Dirt trails of the Tataviam Mountains (east of Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A second band of these paramilitary vigilantes will intercept you in the middle of the mountain range and open fire without a word.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Keep your distance on the mountain slopes to avoid being surrounded from the high ground of the hillside.
  • ›Reward: Roughly $700 in wads of bills picked up from the ground, plus assault rifles.

Border Patrol 3

Raton Canyon

Ambush in Raton Canyon

  • ›Location: Rugged paths of Raton Canyon (Blaine County).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The third and last cell of militiamen will ambush you near the natural canyon. Neutralize every member of the gang to secure the area.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Use throwable explosives or sniper rifles if you manage to spot them before they leave their vehicles.
  • ›Reward: Up to $700 in cash dropped by the enemies and heavy ammo.

🪦 Burial in Paleto Bay

North Point · Paleto Bay

The Rescue of Antonia Bottino

  • ›Location: A coastal clearing at North Point, north of Paleto Bay (Blaine County).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will find two armed mob hitmen with shovels digging a ditch to bury a bound woman alive. Quickly kill the two executioners before they carry out the execution and untie the victim, who will reveal herself to be Antonia Bottino, daughter of the renowned Liberty City boss Sammy Bottino. Put her in your vehicle and drive her safely to Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you are playing as Michael or Franklin, take her to her destination without hesitation. After a few days of play, her father will contact you to transfer a sizable bank deposit as thanks.
  • ›If you are playing as Trevor Philips, you will get the option to detour to Mount Chiliad and hand her over to the Altruists cult for a quick $1,000, though you will lose the $60,000 reward from the mob.
  • ›Reward: Immediate refill of the special bar and $60,000 in your bank account, received days later by email from her father (or $1,000 at the Altruist camp with Trevor).

Vinewood Tour Bus

Alta Street · Downtown Vinewood

The Los Santos Star Route

  • ›Location: Alta Street, in front of the Chinese Theatre in Downtown Vinewood (available only during daytime hours).
  • ›Encounter Overview: An open-top bus from the Vinewood Star Tours agency waits for passengers to take a guided tour of the celebrity mansions, Richards Majestic Studios and the city's architectural landmarks.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You can hop on the tour by paying a small ticket fee ($40). The ride offers comedic commentary and biting trivia about the history of cinema and Los Santos celebrities. If you don't want to listen to the whole tour, you can skip from one stop to the next with the skip button.
  • ›Reward: Environmental lore and satirical dialogue about the entertainment industry (no material rewards).

Car Theft 1 (Pink Peyote)

Great Ocean Highway · North Chumash

Chase on the Pacific Coast

  • ›Location: Great Ocean Highway, near the Hookies biker bar (North Chumash).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A woman cries out for help after being forcibly stripped of her brand-new classic Vapid Peyote convertible. The thief makes a run for it at top speed along the coastal highway.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Shoot the Peyote's tires or cut off its path with your vehicle to force the driver to stop. Once the criminal is down, you face a dilemma:
  • ›Return the car: You will get a valuable boost to your protagonist's driving skill.
  • ›Keep the vehicle: This model has an exclusive metallic bubblegum pink paint job that cannot be faithfully replicated at Los Santos Customs. You can store it in your personal garage.
  • ›Reward: +5 points in the Driving skill (if you return it) or the unique pink Peyote (if you keep it).

Car Theft 2 (Obey Rocoto)

Exceptionalists Way · International Airport (LSIA)

Assault at the Airport Terminal

  • ›Location: Exceptionalists Way, near Los Santos International Airport.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A mugger violently takes the luxury Obey Rocoto SUV from a business executive who was about to catch a flight. Chase the offender before he gets onto the city freeway.
  • ›Tactical Tip: If you return the vehicle to its owner, days later you will receive a formal email from her saying she has ordered an exclusive high-end tailored formal suit, placed directly in the character's wardrobe.
  • ›Reward: +5 points in the Driving skill and an exclusive luxury suit in the wardrobe (if you return it), or the Obey Rocoto SUV in an exclusive dark red (if you keep it).

Robbers in Hawick (The Lost MC)

Hawick Avenue · Hawick

Armed Robbery at SubUrban

  • ›Location: Hawick Avenue, next to the SubUrban clothing store.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two motorized gunmen from The Lost MC biker gang rob a neighboring business, leaving the manager badly wounded on the floor as they flee on their motorcycles with a bag full of cash.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase them and take out both bikers on the move. After picking up the bag with the loot, you can choose to return it to the shopkeeper or keep it:
  • ›Returning the loot will earn you a $200 reward and instantly refill the special bar.
  • ›Keeping the loot will give you the full $2,000 in cash.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 in cash (if you keep the money) or $200 + an instant special ability recharge (if you return it).

Robbers in Textile City (The Lost MC)

San Andreas Avenue · Textile City

Street Snatch in the Textile District

  • ›Location: San Andreas Avenue, in the very heart of the bustling Textile City district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two riders from The Lost MC biker club mug a passerby with a violent snatch, grabbing his wallet before fleeing by weaving through city traffic.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Ram their motorcycle from behind or shoot them through the windshield. Once they are neutralized, pick up the wad from the ground and decide its fate:
  • ›Returning the money to the victim will give you 10% of the haul ($50) and restore the special bar to maximum.
  • ›Keeping it will give you the full $500.
  • ›Reward: $500 in cash (if you keep it) or $50 and a full special ability refill (if you return it).

Robbers in Grapeseed (The Lost MC)

Grapeseed Main Street · Grapeseed

Rural Assault by Van

  • ›Location: Grapeseed's main street, in the farming area north of the Alamo Sea.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Several members of The Lost MC mug a local resident and flee aboard a Gang Burrito van toward the farm fields.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The van is heavy but sturdy. Shoot directly at the rear tires or at the driver to cut the chase short on the narrow dirt roads.
  • ›Reward: $250 clean (if you keep the money) or $25 and a full refill of the special bar (if you return the wallet to the mugged resident).

Robbers on Route 68 (The Lost MC)

Route 68 · Grand Senora Desert

Robbery at the Checkout! Supermarket

  • ›Location: Checkout! gas station and supermarket on Route 68 (Grand Senora Desert).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A van of The Lost MC mugs a customer leaving the store and speeds off down the county road.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase the van before it reaches the Senora Freeway interstate, where interception maneuvers become much harder because of the dense heavy-truck traffic.
  • ›Reward: $120 in cash (if you keep the loot) or $12 and a full special ability recharge (if you give it back to the victim).

Construction Site Accident

Calais Avenue · Little Seoul

Race-Against-Time Rescue at the Construction Site

  • ›Location: Calais Avenue, on a construction lot in the Little Seoul district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A fatal collapse of heavy industrial steel pipes crushes the cab of a service truck (Utility Truck), leaving a worker trapped among the steel. To make matters worse, the truck's fuel tank starts burning with open flames: you have only a few seconds before a catastrophic explosion.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Don't try to pull the worker out on foot or shoot the vehicle. Immediately hop into the bulldozer (Dozer) parked a few meters from the wreck and use the front blade to forcefully push aside the metal pipes blocking the driver's door. Once they are cleared, the worker will jump to safety just before the detonation.
  • ›Reward: +2 Driving skill points and the satisfaction of a perfect rescue.

Shootout at Alamo Sea

Marina Drive · Alamo Sea

Ambush of the Smuggler at the Marina

  • ›Location: Marina Drive, on the north shore of the Alamo Sea (Blaine County). Available only when playing as Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A heavily armed man is pinned down behind a van, locked in an intense shootout with a gang of bikers from The Lost MC. Help him fend off the initial shooters.
  • ›Tactical Tip: As soon as you take out the first bikers, don't let your guard down: the survivor will run toward his vehicle, and at that moment a second wave of reinforcements will burst in on motorcycles, firing continuous bursts. Protect him by taking down the newcomers before they riddle him with bullets.
  • ›Reward: $1,000 in cash, handed to you by the smuggler as a reward for saving his life.

Robbery in Harmony ($10,000)

Route 68 · Harmony

Crossfire and the Forgotten Briefcases

  • ›Location: A clearing next to Route 68, near the town of Harmony (Grand Senora Desert).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will stumble right into a fierce open-field shootout between rural police officers and a gang of armed robbers who have just held up an armored truck or a business. Two briefcases full of wads of bills lie on the ground.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Keep your distance while they kill each other. When the guards take down the robbers (or if you decide to speed things up by shooting from afar), wait for the line of sight to clear, quickly grab the two briefcases ($5,000 each) and get out of the perimeter before reinforcements arrive with patrol cars.
  • ›Reward: Up to $10,000 in cash split between the two abandoned briefcases.

Crash Rescue (Taliana Martinez)

Great Ocean Highway · Mount Chiliad

The Most Valuable Driver in San Andreas

  • ›Location: Great Ocean Highway, on the coastal stretch at the foot of Mount Chiliad (available after completing the story mission The Jewel Store Job).
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will spot an overturned, burning car in the ditch after a high-speed crash. Near the car lies a badly injured woman calling for help: she is Taliana Martinez, a seasoned getaway driver whose own gang betrayed her and left her behind after a heist.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Put her in your vehicle immediately and drive at top speed to the safe house in Sandy Shores. A health bar will gradually drain on screen: drive aggressively, but avoid sharp collisions that would speed up the passenger's death.
  • ›Reward: Permanent unlock of Taliana Martinez as a getaway driver for all of the story's Heists. She is the best crew member in the whole campaign: she has near-maximum driving stats (identical to Eddie Toh) but charges only a 5% cut, which will save you millions of dollars in net takes.

Deal Gone Wrong ($25,000)

Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness · Great Ocean Highway

The Bloody Briefcase in the Nature Reserve

  • ›Location: A clearing hidden among the hills of the Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness, just east of the Great Ocean Highway.
  • ›Encounter Overview: This event is an explicit homage to the cult film No Country for Old Men. You will find several bullet-riddled pickup trucks, bloody corpses and dead guard dogs after a drug deal that ended in carnage. At the end of the rocky trail, a dying survivor whispers to you not to go down for the briefcase before he expires.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Go down to the bottom of the ravine and pick up the silver briefcase with $25,000 in cash. If you get into a vehicle to flee by road, two pickup trucks with heavily armed gunmen will show up to ambush you. Tactical trick: if, after grabbing the money, you leave the canyon on foot by climbing the slope toward the highway before getting into a car, the hitmen's ambush will not trigger and you will avoid the shootout entirely.
  • ›Reward: The full $25,000 in cash inside the briefcase + up to $1,000 more dropped by the pursuing hitmen.

Domestic Dispute (Castro Lagano)

Didion Drive · Vinewood Hills

The Golfer Thrown Out of the House

  • ›Location: Didion Drive, in a luxury housing development in Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will witness a heated marital argument at the door of a mansion. An angry woman kicks her unfaithful husband out of the house, throwing his golf bag onto the sidewalk. The man, named Castro Lagano, will beg you to drive him to the Los Santos Golf Club.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you are playing as Michael or Franklin, take him to the golf club. He will give you an $80 tip and unlock as an expert golf opponent, letting you play high-level rounds to perfect your strength stat.
  • ›If you are playing as Trevor Philips, you can choose to detour into the mountains and sell him to the Altruists cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: An $80 tip and Castro Lagano unlocked as a golf rival (or $1,000 for handing him over to the Altruist cult with Trevor).

Weed Farm Raid ($70,000)

Mount Chiliad · Blaine County

The Drug Lords' Secret Plantation

  • ›Location: Eastern slope of Mount Chiliad (Blaine County). Available only with Trevor Philips.
  • ›Encounter Overview: In the middle of the mountains hides a weed-growing plantation heavily guarded by an armed militia. As you approach, the guards will open fire immediately without warning.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Use Trevor's Rage mode to clear out the shooters posted behind the barricades and wooden sheds without taking critical damage. Once the compound is clear, enter the main shed and open the briefcase on the floor. Also check the inside of the shed: one of the 50 spaceship parts collectibles is there.
  • ›Reward: Up to $70,000 in cash inside the briefcase and a spaceship part. The plantation reactivates periodically every few weeks of in-game time, becoming a recurring source of easy money for Trevor.

Drunk Driver 1

Aguja Street · La Puerta

The Intoxicated Friend Outside the Bar

  • ›Location: Aguja Street, outside a busy bar in the La Puerta harbor district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A visibly desperate man tries in vain to get a completely drunk friend, who can barely stand, into his car. He will ask you to drive the SUV and take the drunk to his apartment on Alta Place, Hawick.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you complete the job by taking him to Hawick, the passenger will give you $80 and hand over his luxury Gallivanter Baller SUV.
  • ›If you are playing as Trevor Philips, you can change the route and drive to the San Chianski / Mount Chiliad mountains to hand him over as a sacrifice to the Altruist Cult, pocketing a clean $1,000 a head.
  • ›Reward: An $80 tip and the Baller SUV (or $1,000 if you hand him over to the Altruists with Trevor).

Drunk Driver 2 (The Sandy Shores Couple)

Armadillo Avenue · Sandy Shores

The Drunk Couple of Sandy Shores

  • ›Location: Armadillo Avenue, outside a motel and saloon in the middle of Sandy Shores.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A couple who have had too much to drink stumble noisily along the sidewalk and beg you to take them back to their motel on Route 68 before the county police arrest them.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you take them to their destination, they will give you a modest $40 tip and you get to keep their Albany Emperor sedan.
  • ›If you are playing as Trevor, this couple is one of the best opportunities in the game to feed the Altruists camp, since they pay $1,000 each ($2,000 in total) and count as two simultaneous victims toward the achievement of unlocking the camp shootout.
  • ›Reward: $40 and the Emperor car (or $2,000 at the Altruist cult if you hand the couple over with Trevor).

Escape Paparazzi (Lacey Jonas)

Vinewood Boulevard · Downtown Vinewood

The Rescue of the Pampered Star

  • ›Location: A narrow alley connected to Vinewood Boulevard, in Downtown Vinewood.
  • ›Encounter Overview: The famous actress and teen diva Lacey Jonas is cornered in an alley by a pack of tabloid photographers with cameras and vehicles. She will beg you to rescue her so that nobody takes any more intrusive photos of her.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Put her in a four-seater enclosed car and start a clean getaway through the avenues of Vinewood. You must dodge and lose the paparazzi vans with tight turns and alleyways; do not shoot or run them over, since causing deaths will fail the mission because of the public scandal.
  • ›Curiosity: If you arrive driving a Vader motorcycle or a Cavalcade, the photographers will mistake Michael for Mitch Dexter, Franklin for the rapper MC Clip and Trevor for the actor Jock Cranley.
  • ›Altruists Option: Trevor can betray Lacey and drive her to the Altruist cult for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: $750 in cash given by Lacey when you reach her mansion (or $1,000 at the Altruist camp with Trevor).

subtitulo: El Rancho Boulevard · El Burro Heights
contenidoMarkdown:
Gang Ambush (Alley Trap)

El Rancho Boulevard · El Burro Heights

The Street Decoy Trap

  • ›Location: Junction of El Rancho Boulevard and Fudge Lane, on the industrial slopes of El Burro Heights.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A tearful young woman on the sidewalk will call out to you urgently, asking you to follow her into a dark alley because she claims someone needs medical help.
  • ›Tactical Tip: It's a premeditated trap. As soon as you turn the corner of the alley, the girl will step aside and a squad of gangsters armed with pistols and shotguns, posted behind dumpsters and fire escapes, will appear. Go in with your weapon drawn or throw a Molotov cocktail as soon as you peek around the corner to neutralize the ambush before they open fire from all sides.
  • ›Reward: Between $200 and $500 in loose cash picked up from the fallen gangsters, plus their weapons and ammo.

Getaway Driver (Patrick 'Packie' McReary)

Strawberry Avenue · Forum Drive

The Reunion with a Liberty City Legend

  • ›Location: Intersection of Strawberry Avenue and Forum Drive (in front of the Dollar Pills pharmacy).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed, hooded men have just held up the pharmacy at gunpoint and are desperately looking for a four-door vehicle to escape. As you approach, you will be amazed to discover that one of the robbers is Patrick "Packie" McReary, the unforgettable Irish mob member and co-star of the famous Three Leaf Clover heist in Grand Theft Auto IV.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Get them into a fast 4-seater car before the police surround them. You will have a 2-star wanted level: lose it in the alleys or along the railroad tracks of Strawberry and drive them to their safe house. Do not kill them under any circumstances, as you would lose one of the best supporting characters in Rockstar's history.
  • ›Reward: $1,000 in cash and, most importantly, you unlock Packie McReary as a shooter / gunman for the story's Heists. He has an 88% shooting skill and asks for only a 12% cut, far outclassing gunmen who demand a much higher percentage.

Hitchhiker 1 (Tinkle Stock Tip)

Ineseno Road · Banham Canyon

The Race Against the Clock to the Airport

  • ›Location: Ineseno Road, in Banham Canyon, next to the shoulder of the Great Ocean Highway.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A financial analyst in an impeccable suit is stranded beside his broken-down car. He will beg you to take him as quickly as possible to the departures terminal of Los Santos International Airport (LSIA) so he doesn't miss a crucial business flight.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have exactly 2 minutes and 20 seconds of real time (a little over 2 in-game hours) to complete the trip. Take the Great Ocean Highway southbound toward the Los Santos Freeway without braking hard.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving points, a $100 tip and the most profitable financial advice among the random events: he will advise you to invest in the telecommunications company Tinkle (TNK) on the BAWSAQ market. Buy shares with all three protagonists immediately after completing the job and hold them for 20 to 24 in-game hours, the exact moment they hit their peak return of 33% before dropping.

Hitchhiker 2 (Ursula)

North Calafia Way · Mount Chiliad

The Encounter with the Hermit of El Gordo

  • ›Location: North Calafia Way, on the southern foot of Mount Chiliad (near the Alamo Sea). Available only when playing as Franklin Clinton or Trevor Philips.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A disheveled young woman named Ursula, with a wild gaze and unsettling behavior, is hitchhiking, soaked in the rain. She will ask you to take her back to her old rustic house on El Gordo Drive, next to the east coast lighthouse.
  • ›Tactical Tip:
  • ›If you take her to her home on the coast, she will thank you for the ride and be added to your phone contacts. When you call her to go out on future dates, her meeting will trigger a unique environmental phenomenon: it will start pouring rain all over San Andreas, which is ideal for activating certain map mysteries (such as the Mount Chiliad UFO at 03:00 AM).
  • ›If you are playing as Trevor, you can ignore her pleas and drive her to the Altruists camp for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving and Ursula unlocked as a special contact (or $1,000 at the Altruist cult with Trevor).

Hitchhiker 3 (Jealous Boyfriend)

East Joshua Road · San Chianski Mountain Range

The Rescue and the Brawl in Vinewood

  • ›Location: Intersection of East Joshua Road with the San Chianski mountain road (Blaine County).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A young girl waves you down on the shoulder asking for a ride back to her home in the Vinewood Hills after being left stranded in the desert.
  • ›Tactical Tip: When you park in front of her house, her romantic partner, a jealous and aggressive guy, will storm out, start insulting you and attack you with bare fists. Get out of the car and face him in hand-to-hand combat: do not use firearms or kill him; knock him out with punches to resolve the altercation without alerting the police.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving points and the passenger's gratitude (or $1,000 if you hand her over to the Altruists with Trevor).

Hitchhiker 4 (Runaway Bride)

Route 68 · Great Chaparral

Escape from the Altar at the Rural Church

  • ›Location: Side tracks of Route 68, next to the chapel in Great Chaparral.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A bride in a white dress runs desperately down the road after fleeing her own wedding at the last moment. She begs you to get her out of there and take her to her apartment on Kimble Hill Drive (Vinewood Hills).
  • ›Tactical Tip: During the trip, the jilted groom will chase you at high speed aboard a Vapid Bobcat pickup, trying to ram your car off the road. You have two tactical options: floor it and lose him thanks to your higher top speed, or brake hard, get out and knock the groom out with your fists (without killing him) to continue the trip in peace.
  • ›Reward: +5 Driving skill (or $1,000 at the Altruist cult if you play as Trevor).

Ambush in La Mesa (Decoy Girl)

Supply Street · La Mesa

The Industrial Ambush

  • ›Location: Supply Street, in the warehouse and factory area of La Mesa (East Los Santos).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A woman fakes a panic attack and begs you to go with her into a dark alley between two industrial buildings on the pretext of tending to an injured person.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Just like in El Burro Heights, it's a trap: as soon as you advance a few steps, an armed accomplice will pop out from behind a dumpster brandishing a suppressed pistol to rob you. Keep your weapon drawn as you turn the corner and take him down with an accurate headshot before he opens fire.
  • ›Reward: Between $10 and $50 in loose cash recovered from the attackers and pistol ammo.

Mugging 1

Strawberry Avenue · Chamberlain Hills

Pickpocket Chase in Chamberlain Hills

  • ›Location: Strawberry Avenue, on the border between Strawberry and Chamberlain Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You will witness a petty thief violently snatch a neighbor's wallet and take off at full speed along the sidewalks and crosswalks.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase the pickpocket on foot or ram him with your vehicle's bumper. Once he is down, pick up the money from the pavement and choose your path:
  • ›Returning the wallet to the victim will reward you with a $20 tip and fill your special ability bar to 100%.
  • ›Keeping the loot will give you $200 in cash.
  • ›Reward: $200 (if you keep the money) or $20 + an instant special ability recharge (if you return it).

Mugging 2

Meteor Street · Hawick

Life-or-Death Rescue in the Alley

  • ›Location: Meteor Street, in a narrow residential alley in the Hawick district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: An attacker armed with a knife corners a defenseless woman against the wall with the clear intention of stabbing her and robbing her of her belongings.
  • ›Tactical Tip: This event demands lightning-fast intervention: if you hesitate for a couple of seconds, the attacker will commit the murder and you will fail the encounter. Aim precisely for the head or shoot him from the alley entrance before he delivers the stab.
  • ›Reward: The attacker's ammo and the satisfaction of having prevented a murder in the middle of the city.

Mugging 3 ($2,000)

Vespucci Boulevard · Pillbox Hill

The Executive's Briefcase in the Financial District

  • ›Location: Vespucci Boulevard at Alta Street, near the skyscrapers of Pillbox Hill.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A mugger knocks down a businessman at the doors of a bank, tearing a leather briefcase from his hands and quickly escaping into the crowd of passersby.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase the criminal and neutralize him before he disappears into the underground subway stations. When you pick up the briefcase, a very tempting financial dilemma arises:
  • ›If you return the briefcase to the executive, you will receive $200 in thanks and your special ability meter will be restored to maximum.
  • ›If you decide to keep it, you will pocket the not-insignificant sum of $2,000 clean in cash.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 in cash (if you keep it) or $200 and a full refill of the special bar (if you return it to the executive).

Prisoner Lift 1

North Bolingbroke · Grand Senora Desert

The Fugitive from the State Prison

  • ›Location: Side roads north of Bolingbroke Penitentiary (Blaine County). Available only with Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton.
  • ›Encounter Overview: An escaped prisoner dressed in the penitentiary's unmistakable orange jumpsuit runs desperately along the shoulder after evading the searchlights and wire fences of the prison. He begs you to take him in your vehicle and drive him to The Lost's clandestine biker club in Sandy Shores.
  • ›Tactical Tip: During the trip, a Corrections Sheriff patrol car will cut you off, triggering a 1-star wanted level. You will have to floor it and break the officers' line of sight on the desert dirt tracks before you can drop the convict off safely at his destination.
  • ›Reward: +3 points in the Driving stat.

Prisoner Lift 2 (Inmate Trap)

South Bolingbroke · Grand Senora Desert

The Ambush of the Overturned Patrol Car

  • ›Location: South edge of Bolingbroke Prison, next to an overturned, burning Sheriff's patrol car in the ditch.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Another inmate in a prison orange jumpsuit signals for help on the shoulder, pretending to be injured and helpless after the police transport van overturned.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Maximum alert! The moment you stop next to him to help, the convict will pull a service pistol stolen from the guards, shove it in your face to throw you out of the driver's seat and try to escape in your own vehicle. Don't brake beside him: get out with your weapon ready or shoot him through the window before he catches you off guard.
  • ›Reward: Pistol ammo and the recovery of your car, intact.

contenidoMarkdown:
Rogue Altruists

Baytree Canyon Road · Grand Senora Desert

The Kidnapping in the Canyon

  • ›Location: Dirt tracks of Baytree Canyon Road, in the hills linking Los Santos with the Grand Senora Desert. Available only to Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two elderly fanatics from the cannibal Altruists cult have a young hiker cornered and defenseless, threatening her with handguns in order to kidnap her and take her to their camp in the mountains.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Immediately shoot both cultists before they open fire on the girl. Once they are dead, interact with the young woman to put her in your car and drive her safely to her home in Sandy Shores.
  • ›The Climax at the Altruist Camp: If, in the other random events, you play as Trevor Philips and choose to hand over a total of 4 victims to the cult on Mount Chiliad, the special camp shootout (Altruist Cult Shootout) will be triggered. The fanatics will try to sacrifice Trevor on the altar; once you wipe them all out, you can freely loot their cabins and collect 4 briefcases with $25,000 each ($100,000 in total), an RPG rocket launcher and body armor vests on the porches.
  • ›Reward: An $80 tip and the hiker's gratitude.

Armored Truck 1 (La Puerta)

Innocence Boulevard · La Puerta

Gruppe Sechs Truck Heist at the Gas Station

  • ›Location: Gas station between Innocence Boulevard and Alta Street (La Puerta).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Gruppe Sechs armored transport truck is parked next to the fuel pumps. An armed security guard comes out of the store carrying a cash case with the takings.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have two operational approaches:
  • ›Precision holdup: Take down the guard before he puts the case in the back of the truck. You will pick up the loot instantly without having to force the vehicle's doors.
  • ›Explosive assault: If the case is already inside, place a sticky bomb (Sticky Bomb) in the center of the rear doors or repeatedly fire a shotgun at the rear lock until the bolts pop. Escape immediately to shake off the two police wanted stars.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Armored Truck 2 (Little Seoul / Lucky Plucker)

Vespucci Boulevard · Little Seoul

Hit on the Lucky Plucker Armored Truck

  • ›Location: Parking lot of the Lucky Plucker restaurant, on Vespucci Boulevard (Little Seoul).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored cash truck is parked while the guards do the shift change and collect the restaurant's safe.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The restaurant's back alley offers an ideal angle to ambush the guard with a suppressed rifle. If the guards panic and start the truck, immediately shoot the wheels to stop them from reaching the main avenue.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Armored Truck 3 (Paleto Bay)

Paleto Boulevard · Paleto Bay

Raid on the Northern Shipment

  • ›Location: Western end of Paleto Boulevard, in front of the banking and shopping area of Paleto Bay.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A Gruppe Sechs truck stopped on the main road of the coastal town, loading the morning cash shipment.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Given the distance from the Los Santos headquarters, the local Sheriff patrols will take a few more seconds to arrive. Blow open the rear hatch with an explosive and flee at top speed along the Great Ocean Highway or toward the forest tracks of Mount Chiliad.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 clean.

Armored Truck 4 (Adam's Apple)

Adam's Apple Boulevard · Little Seoul

Ambush in the Shopping Parking Lot

  • ›Location: A small shopping parking lot on Adam's Apple Boulevard (Little Seoul).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored truck stops to pick up the daily takings from several neighboring businesses.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Use a heavy vehicle to block the parking lot exit before attacking. Neutralize the two uniformed guards, blow the rear door and use the narrow streets of Little Seoul to shake off the police helicopter.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in bills.

Armored Truck 5 (Vespucci Canals)

Prosperity Street · Vespucci Canals

Moving Heist along the Canals

  • ›Location: Prosperity Street, in the Vespucci Canals sector (the vehicle travels northbound).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Unlike the parked armored trucks, this Gruppe Sechs truck is in the middle of a moving transport route, escorted by two guards in the cab.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Overtake the truck and block its path on one of the narrow canal bridges. Place a sticky bomb on the rear hatch and detonate it so the case drops onto the asphalt. After grabbing it, jump on foot into the canal boats or flee under the bridges to shake off the police helicopter.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Armored Truck 6 (Little Seoul / Hit 'n' Run)

San Andreas Avenue · Little Seoul

Urban Ambush on San Andreas Avenue

  • ›Location: San Andreas Avenue, level with the Hit 'n' Run Coffee cafe (Little Seoul, heading east).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored truck drives along one of the busiest arteries of downtown Los Santos.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Shoot the tires with an armor-piercing pistol or a submachine gun from the window to make the truck skid and hit the traffic lights. Take out the armed agents before they get out with shotguns and blow the rear doors.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in wads of bills.

Armored Truck 7 (San Chianski)

Chianski Passage · San Chianski Mountain Range

Isolated Heist in the Eastern Mountains

  • ›Location: Chianski Passage mountain pass, near the lookout post in the San Chianski mountain range (heading north).
  • ›Encounter Overview: A cash transport truck traveling between cities along the lonely road that skirts the east coast of San Andreas.
  • ›Tactical Tip: This is one of the most convenient and safest truck heists in the whole guide: since it's deep in the mountains with no civilians or heavy traffic, police patrols take quite a while to respond. Ram it, blow the rear door and hide in the adjacent sea cliffs.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Armored Truck 8 (Tongva Hills)

Great Ocean Highway · Tongva Hills

Chase on the West Coast Highway

  • ›Location: Stretch of the Great Ocean Highway level with the Tongva Hills (near the junction with Route 68, heading south).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The armored cash truck travels at high speed along the highway, skirting the vineyards and coastal cliffs.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Throw a sticky bomb directly at the rear hatch while you drive behind or alongside it. Detonate the explosive on the move: the case will be flung onto the shoulder, letting you brake, grab it and climb the dirt tracks of Marlowe Vineyards before the police cordon forms.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Armored Truck 9 (Cypress Flats)

El Rancho Boulevard · Cypress Flats

Heist in the Cypress Flats Industrial Park

  • ›Location: El Rancho Boulevard, near Orchardville Avenue in the manufacturing heart of Cypress Flats (heading west).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The Gruppe Sechs armored truck drives through the area of warehouses and heavy factories in southeast Los Santos.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Cross your vehicle in front of it to force it to stop among the warehouses. After blowing the lock and grabbing the case, flee toward the concrete bed of the Los Santos River or the nearby underground freight rail tracks to instantly lose the two wanted stars.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 clean.

Armored Truck 10 (La Mesa)

Supply Street · La Mesa

Ambush in the La Mesa Rail Corridor

  • ›Location: Supply Street, near Popular Street (La Mesa, heading south).
  • ›Encounter Overview: The last of the ten Gruppe Sechs cash trucks travels through La Mesa's logistics district, skirting the railroad tracks and scrapyards.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Throw a sticky bomb or intercept the vehicle at the level crossing. After blowing the rear doors and picking up the case, escape by dropping down to the underground tram tracks or toward the river canal to instantly get rid of your wanted level.
  • ›Reward: Between $3,000 and $8,000 in cash.

Bob Mulet Hair Salon Robbery ($2,000)

Eastbourne Way · Rockford Hills

The Raid on the Luxury Barbershop

  • ›Location: Bob Mulet hair salon on Eastbourne Way, in the exclusive Rockford Hills shopping district.
  • ›Encounter Overview: As you approach or enter the establishment, you will witness two armed robbers holding the staff at gunpoint to steal the takings. The criminals run out and get into a sedan parked at the curb to flee at top speed through the hills.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Chase the robbers' car and shoot accurately through the windows to eliminate the driver and his accomplice. When you pick up the bag of money from the ground, you will have the option of going back to the barbershop and returning it to the owner or keeping all of it.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 in cash if you keep the stolen money.

SubUrban Store Robbery (25% Discount)

Prosperity Street Promenade · Del Perro

Armed Robbery at the Clothing Store

  • ›Location: SubUrban clothing store on the pedestrian boulevard of Prosperity Street Promenade (Del Perro).
  • ›Encounter Overview: Two armed thieves hit the SubUrban store's cash register and flee along the pedestrian promenade, firing into the air to scatter passersby.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Neutralize the fugitives before they reach a vehicle on the main avenue and pick up the bag with the stolen money.
  • ›If you decide to keep the bag, you will get $2,000 in cash.
  • ›If you go back to the store and return the takings to the clerks, you will unlock a permanent shopping perk: a 25% discount on your next clothing purchase at any store in the SubUrban chain.
  • ›Reward: $2,000 (if you keep the money) or a 25% discount on SubUrban clothing (if you return it).

Revenge on Simeon Yetarian

Power Street · Strawberry

Settling Scores at the Dealership

  • ›Location: Premium Deluxe Motorsport dealership, at the intersection of Adam's Apple Boulevard and Power Street (Strawberry).
  • ›Spawn Condition: Available only when playing as Michael De Santa or Franklin Clinton within the time window between the story missions Friend Request and The Jewel Store Job.
  • ›Encounter Overview: After cutting business ties with Simeon over his corrupt, abusive repossession business, if you enter the dealership Simeon will recognize you instantly and fly into a rage, ordering his armed bodyguards to kill you right there, shouting "Traitor!".
  • ›Tactical Tip: Take cover behind the columns or the display vehicles and take out the two thugs opening fire on you. Simeon will run panic-stricken into the back room: the game lets you decide whether to spare his life or gun down the usurer to settle old scores for good.
  • ›Reward: Story lore, personal satisfaction and the bodyguards' weapons/ammo.

contenidoMarkdown:
Lost Hostage (Snatched)

South Mo Milton Drive · Vinewood Hills

The Kidnapping in the Vinewood Hills

  • ›Location: South Mo Milton Drive, on a lonely bend in the residential hills of Vinewood Hills.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Several armed members of The Lost MC biker gang try to kidnap a young woman, beating her into the back of a black Gang Burrito van.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Step in right away by taking down the bikers before the van starts. Put the victim in your car and get ready for a violent chase: several Lost motorcycles will pursue you firing sawed-off shotguns while you take her to her destination.
  • ›Altruists Option: If you are playing as Trevor Philips, you can betray the girl and hand her over to the Altruists cult on Mount Chiliad for $1,000.
  • ›Reward: The victim's gratitude (or $1,000 at the Altruist camp with Trevor).

Sport Bike Theft (Bati 801)

North Rockford Drive · Richman

Chase through the Streets of Richman

  • ›Location: North Rockford Drive, in the exclusive residential neighborhood of Richman.
  • ›Encounter Overview: A citizen cries out for help after being forcibly stripped of his brand-new Pegassi Bati 801 sport bike by a criminal who makes a run for it at top speed.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Get in a fast vehicle or chase the assailant right away. Shoot the tires or ram him to bring him down without destroying the bike. If the thief hits the ground, neutralize him before he returns fire.
  • ›Dilemma and Reward: You can ride the motorcycle back to the victim to return it and receive +5 Driving skill points, or keep the customized Pegassi Bati 801 and store it in your personal garage.

Bachelor Party (Stag Do)

Route 68 · Great Chaparral

The Bachelor Party Prank

  • ›Location: Side of Route 68, in the semi-desert area of Great Chaparral.
  • ›Encounter Overview: You find a half-naked man in his underwear, tied with duct tape and ropes to a telegraph pole. When you free him, he will tell you, embarrassed, that his friends went too far with the pranks at his bachelor party and that he must make it on time to the wedding in Paleto Bay before his fiancée calls off the ceremony.
  • ›Tactical Tip: You have a strict limit of 5 in-game hours. Put him in your car and complete the itinerary in stages: first drive him to his mansion in Rockford Hills so he can dress formally and take his car keys; next, stop by the Hookies restaurant in North Chumash to pick up another straggling groomsman, and finally drive at top speed to the church in Paleto Bay before time runs out.
  • ›Altruists Option: If you are playing as Trevor Philips, you can choose to ignore his pleas and hand him over to the Altruists camp on Mount Chiliad in exchange for a $1,000 reward.
  • ›Reward: If you complete the rescue successfully, the groom will reward you with the keys to his luxurious white Enus Super Diamond sedan.

Duel: Imponte Duke O'Death

Route 68 · Grand Senora Desert

Ambush at the Desert Gas Station

  • ›Location: Abandoned gas station and cafe next to Route 68, west of Los Santos Customs in the Grand Senora Desert.
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Available only in the Enhanced editions (PS4, Xbox One, PC and next-generation consoles) after completing the main mission Mr. Philips with Trevor.
  • ›Encounter Overview: In the gas station's parking lot you will spot an imposing armored vehicle: the fearsome Imponte Duke O'Death. However, it is an ambush planned by a gang of local rednecks.
  • ›Tactical Tip: The moment you get into the vehicle, several JoBuilt Phantom heavy trucks and Karin Rebel and Dubsta SUVs will block the exits and try to ram you while firing. Take advantage of the Duke O'Death's front armor and reinforced windows to fight back, ram through their blockades, or get out and take cover with explosives and heavy rifles to wipe out all the aggressors.
  • ›Reward: Permanent unlock of the Imponte Duke O'Death. From this point on, it will respawn guaranteed at the El Burro Heights scrapyard and in the Grand Senora Desert, and it will become available for purchase through Warstock Cache & Carry.

Dodo Seaplane (Sea Cave)

Sea Cave · East Coast (San Chianski)

Raid on the Smugglers' Grotto

  • ›Location: Large sea cave hidden in the cove east of the RON Alternates Wind Farm and the San Chianski Mountain Range.
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Available in the Enhanced versions after completing the main mission Nervous Ron.
  • ›Encounter Overview: Enter the cave by sea (by boat, jet ski or swimming). Inside the grotto you will find a contingent of heavily armed traffickers guarding a coveted Mammoth Dodo seaplane moored in the inner dock.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Eliminate the guards posted on the walkways and the Squalo patrol boats. Once you take the Dodo's controls, two more armed boats will appear to block your exit. Floor it down the water channel inside the cavern and take off to open sea, dodging the crossfire.
  • ›Reward: Unlock of the Mammoth Dodo for free pickup at the Galilee pier (Alamo Sea) and on the Vinewood Hills lake, plus purchase from the Elitás Travel online catalog ($500,000).

Monkey Mosaics (Space Monkey)

Los Santos Customs · Burton

The Signature of the Space Monkey Street Artist

  • ›Location: Back alley adjacent to the Los Santos Customs garage in the Burton district (Los Santos).
  • ›Unlock Requirement: Available in the Enhanced versions after locating and photographing with your cell phone camera all 50 Space Monkey mosaics scattered across the walls of San Andreas.
  • ›Encounter Overview: When you complete the last of the 50 mosaics, you will receive an email warning you that the elusive graffiti artist has been seen finishing one last urban piece in Burton.
  • ›Tactical Tip: Head to the marked location with absolute stealth. Upon reaching the mouth of the alley, move forward crouched and use your phone camera's zoom from mid-range to frame the graffiti artist as he sprays the wall. Warning: if you make the noise of hurried footsteps or get too close, the artist will abort the painting in a panic and flee before you can photograph him.
  • ›Reward: Immediate unlock of the exclusive sports vehicle Dinka Go Go Monkey Blista in the garage of each of the three protagonists, along with a collection of Space Monkey-themed clothing and outfits in their wardrobes.
